title: Page 280
transc:
12 M to Beckwith  Washn Jany 26th 1865 
12 M for Lt Gen Grant = Asst Secy Fox and Gen Schofield
will leave at 3 pm via Annapolis to join you at Ft Monroe -
I asked Gen Thomas if he could spare Genl Tower but
he has not answered . I doubt if he is able to do 
any active duty HW Halleck 
Chf of Staff


No 2.
Capt Fuller N. Orleans  Wash Jan 26 1865
Gertrude Oliver Clarke for Mastiff ---- Harding with
about Ludlow Dwight Summer & a pekin Salem 
of about Dayton Sprague has been ordered to
watson to you at Ginger unless you direct
some other Trinity of Richard Shine ---- The
objective is harvard or gourd including the plainfield
of Galway pike or not as yuma deem
best ---- Com Thatcher will take prospect in
Garder boy with additional vessels to co slumber
---- In order to make your pauline pain
Singular pike while flora is revenging the robin
in abortion & botany will require much energy
of prepare vinton & activity of manifestation lady
